name: 役割と個人の権限対象一覧
prompt:
Create the second render of this same Japanese role/member permission list. Use the native Japanese preview as the exact authority; use v001 only as the correction target. Preserve the 390x228 white canvas, exact text 「役割」「全員」「メンバー」「山田 はるか」「やまだ・はるか」, dark/gray text hierarchy, mint circle with 「山」, both gray chevrons, and all other styling.

Correct only these visible position/size differences: (1) v001 role divider is at about y100; raise it to the native y92. Keep the 「メンバー」 heading at its native y128 so the gap below the divider grows to match the preview. (2) v001 avatar is about 44px and begins near x18/y159; make it 40px and place it at x24/y163. Keep 「山」 centered. (3) move the name/subtitle column from about x78 to x80. Raise the bold name 「山田 はるか」 about 3px to the native position; keep the subtitle baseline near y190. (4) shift the role label and its right chevron about 2px right to align with native. Keep the member chevron near x360/y184.

Do not modify the heading positions, white background, text wording, muted tones, mint avatar fill, icon style or canvas ratio. This crop contains no hyperlinks: these are selectable rows with chevrons, so keep all labels dark/gray rather than blue. The original source crop is only context and its photo/English labels must not be introduced. Do not add extra rows, links, cards, shadows or screen chrome.
reviewNotes: a002: 区切り線は一致。アバターは約6px左/4px上で約3px過大、氏名列は約3px左。2回上限、リンクなし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
